title: Study on the quantitative detection of SO2F2 based on spectral analysis combined with laser spectroscopy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19421-19430
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06854H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhigang Cao, Bin Liu, Yinghan Xiang, Shuai Liang, Xu Guo
Accurate monitoring of trace SO2F2 inside SF6 gas-insulated equipment is helpful for equipment fault diagnosis. In this paper, the detection of SO2F2 based on laser absorption spectroscopy was studied, and high selectivity and high sensitivity detection was achieved.
